name: Bambu Lab P1S

keepout.note: Bed exclusion from the bundled 0.4 mm nozzle profile in Bambu Studio 02.09.01.70.

warn.PC: Enclosed but no active chamber heating: fine for small parts, larger ones may warp.
warn.PA: Dry the filament first; passive enclosure only.
warn.PLA-CF: Abrasive: fit a hardened steel nozzle (stock nozzle is stainless steel).
warn.PETG-CF: Abrasive: fit a hardened steel nozzle (stock nozzle is stainless steel).
warn.PA-CF: Abrasive and warp-prone: hardened nozzle, dry filament.

notes: The bundled 0.4 mm nozzle profile in Bambu Studio 02.09.01.70 defaults to 250 mm of printable height.
Open the lid or door for PLA/PETG so the chamber does not overheat.

clearance_mm.note: Starting values per side, for PLA at 0.2 mm layers. Replace with tolerance-coupon measurements.

spec_note: Nominal build volume, included nozzle, hotend and bed limits checked against the first listed Bambu Lab document on 2026-11-20. Slicer exclusions, clearance values and optional transfer compatibility are separate from manufacturer hardware specifications.
